ideas.pitch: An AI-powered transit coordination app for the Lower Mainland that groups students and commuters in Burnaby into dynamic carpools and shuttle schedules based on real-time SkyTrain delays.
ideas.title: PacificTransit Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting a problem every judge in Burnaby faces daily—commuting to the venue or campus—makes the pain instantly relatable, matching the pattern of solving problems judges feel themselves.

ideas.pitch: Computer vision and satellite monitoring tool designed to track green space usage, urban heat islands, and infrastructure wear across university campuses in British Columbia.
ideas.title: CampusScan AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines clear, measurable environmental impact with spatial data, following the pattern of high-scoring geospatial and resource-monitoring hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: A localized predictive forecasting tool that ingests regional weather data and historical telemetry to output hyper-local wildfire risk metrics and evacuation bottlenecks for local municipalities.
ideas.title: BC Wildfire Risk Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages statistical forecasting and high-stakes risk modeling, mimicking the exact architecture of winning prediction and regression hacks.

ideas.pitch: An explainable graph intelligence and risk-scoring dashboard that detects anomalous student loan and micro-transaction patterns for local credit unions.
ideas.title: FinTech Guard BC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard engineering by combining graph databases with explainable machine learning models for financial compliance.

ideas.pitch: A localized dietary planning assistant that optimizes meal recommendations based on real-time inventory and pricing from grocery stores across Burnaby.
ideas.title: LocalBites AI Nutrition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers concrete economic and health benefits tailored to local student budgets, following the blueprint of successful wellness hackathon winners.
